description:
Design-only story. Produce the proxy-type architecture for `FieldMatrix<F>` arithmetic so that expressions like `&a * &b + &c` and `alpha * &a + &b` evaluate without unnecessary temporaries, matching Armadillo's expression-template ergonomics in idiomatic Rust.

## Deliverables

1. `dev/plans/expression_templates_design.md` — specifies:
   - Every proxy struct (`Product`, `Sum`, `Scale`, `Transposed`, `FusedProductPlus`, …) and the trait bounds that compose them.
   - Which expressions are **fused** at evaluation time (minimum: `A·B + βC` → one fgemm call; `αA + B`; `Aᵀ·B`) and which fall back to eager evaluation.
   - The `Evaluate<F>` trait (or equivalent) and its `evaluate_into(&mut FieldMatrix<F>)` contract.
   - How `FieldMatrix<F>::from(expr)` bridges from proxy types back to owned matrices.
   - Shape-check rules at construction (proxy-time) vs. at evaluation (allocation-time).
   - The exact method signatures of `a.t()`, `&a * &b`, `scalar * &a`, and friends — both eager and lazy variants.
2. Worked examples in the design doc showing generated SSA / call graph for the fused paths.
3. Consistency note: every proxy must also implement `MatrixLike<F>` where possible (read-only), so algorithms written against `MatrixLike` accept lazy expressions.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Design doc reviewed and approved by lead before any implementation in `d48a3cfd`, `c3f8c1cb`, `ae1d1e88`, or `N2` starts. The `doc-review` gate is the lead's attestation mechanism; this criterion is satisfied when both `code-review` and `doc-review` gates on this issue pass.
- [hard] Doc enumerates at least the four canonical fusions (fgemm with β, `A·B + αC`, `αA + βB`, `Aᵀ·B`); for each, describes how the proxy chain collapses into a single kernel call.
- [hard] Doc specifies the rules that prevent accidental eager evaluation at intermediate points (e.g. moving the proxy into a `let` binding of owned `FieldMatrix` type).
- [hard] Doc describes interaction with the `MatrixLike<F>` trait and how views participate.
- [aspirational] Compile-time verification that the canonical `(&a * &b + &c).into::<FieldMatrix<F>>()` path emits one fgemm call at `-O3` — amended 2026-04-24 to defer the `cargo asm` inspection to implementation story `d48a3cfd` (subtask `7e6183bb`), per §11.4 of the design doc. The design specifies the requirement ("one kernel symbol per canonical fusion") and `d48a3cfd` carries the empirical verification as a task-level criterion.

## Non-goals

- No implementation of the proxy types yet — that lands in `d48a3cfd` alongside matmul, using this design as the blueprint.
- Not extending the proxy layer to sparse matrices in this story — sparse (8a90882e) may reuse what applies, but its design is out of scope here.

title: Design FieldMatrix expression-template algebra (proxy types)
